text: The aim of this study was to examine the psychometric properties of Form A of the Test of Nonverbal Intelligence–Third Edition (TONI-3) in Turkish middle school students aged 10 years 0 months to 14 years 0 months. Although TONI-3 has previously been validated in Turkish children and late adolescents, psychometric evidence for early adolescence remains limited.
source_label: Psychometric properties of the test of nonverbal intelligence–third edition (TONI-3) in Turkish middle school students
